sub_graphs.title: BLAKE2b: G-Function Mixing Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models the G-function mixing operations that form the core of BLAKE2 compression

nodes.label: G-Function Input State
nodes.description: Work vector elements a, b, c, d selected with inputs x, y

nodes.label: Add a + b + x
nodes.description: a := (a + b + x) mod 2^64

nodes.label: XOR and Rotate d
nodes.description: d := (d XOR a) >>> R1 (R1=32 for Blake2b)

nodes.label: Add c + d
nodes.description: c := (c + d) mod 2^64

nodes.label: XOR and Rotate b
nodes.description: b := (b XOR c) >>> R2 (R2=24 for Blake2b)

nodes.label: Add a + b + y
nodes.description: a := (a + b + y) mod 2^64

nodes.label: XOR and Rotate d (second)
nodes.description: d := (d XOR a) >>> R3 (R3=16 for Blake2b)

nodes.label: Add c + d (second)
nodes.description: c := (c + d) mod 2^64

nodes.label: XOR and Rotate b (second)
nodes.description: b := (b XOR c) >>> R4 (R4=63 for Blake2b)

nodes.label: G-Function Output State
nodes.description: Updated work vector elements a, b, c, d

ambiguities.text: No explicit error handling documentation for invalid input parameters
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume invalid inputs cause precompile failure with all gas consumed, consistent with other Ethereum precompiles.

ambiguities.text: The module 'assumes correct byte sequence lengths and offsets' without specifying what happens for incorrect values
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume malformed input results in precompile revert. Security analysis should consider edge cases around parameter boundaries.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLAKE2 implementation correctly follows RFC 7693 and produces cryptographically secure output
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect implementation could enable hash collisions or preimage attacks, undermining cryptographic security guarantees.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot find inputs that cause the compression function to produce predictable or exploitable outputs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could enable hash collision attacks or signature forgery in systems relying on BLAKE2.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas cost per round (1 gas) accurately reflects computational cost across all implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced gas could enable DoS attacks; overpriced gas wastes user resources.

implicit_assumptions.description: 64-bit arithmetic operations with mask 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF correctly prevent overflow
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Integer overflow could produce incorrect hash outputs or enable exploitation of arithmetic boundaries.
